A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a new low-complexity MIMO detection algorithm that achieves a good tradeoff between performance and complexity by exploiting the tree-search algorithm and the hierarchical set partition.

we have proposed a novel low-complextiy tree-search (TS)-based soft-output MIMO detection algorithm, which is called a hierarchical tree search, and we have shown through simulation that it has a superior performance-complexity characteristic compared with the existing algorithms in terms of the performance-complexitity tradeoff in various MIMO scenarios.

the HTS algorithm can be a good alternative for practical applications of soft-output MIMO detection.
the proposed hierarchical tree search algorithm can be a promising candidate for the soft-output MIMO detection in the 5G and beyond wireless communication systems.
the HTS algorithm is a good alternative for the TS algorithms when the runtime constraint is imposed.
